errors.evidence: The description states that the vertical axis has a scale from 0% to 50% with 10% intervals, but the y-axis in the figure has no visible scale, tick marks, or labels.
The description uses the label "В страна" for the green bars, but the legend specifies the label as "В страната".
The description claims that some of the bars are shaded, but all bars are filled with solid colors.
